string.text: Recoil compensator
Allows you to reduce the recoil felt by the shooter by changing the direction of exit of powder gases from the barrel.
Wear-resistant attachment attachment
Significantly slows down the wear of the weapon, especially when used in conjunction with a standard silencer.
Barrel with modified rifling pitch
Changing the pitch of the rifling in the bore of a weapon allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet and reduce the spread of hits when firing.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets when firing a weapon, which increases the accuracy and accuracy of fire.
Protective coating
Applying a special coating to weapon parts can significantly slow down its wear.
Refinement of the extractor
Allows you to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.
Improved bore locking mechanism
Minimizes backlash and clearances, allowing you to increase the pressure in the barrel bore and increase the initial velocity of the bullet.
Chamber adjustment
Allows you to improve obturation and achieve higher shooting accuracy.
Alloy frame
Replacing a standard weapon frame with a lightweight analogue allows you to gain weight in the weapon, without losing in reliability and other characteristics.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows firing at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Replacing handle pads

Replacing the linings on the weapon's handles with more modern foreign analogues does not change the appearance, but has a beneficial effect on the ease of holding the weapon and the accuracy of firing from it.
Polymer buffer
The introduction of an additional polymer buffer into the recoil mechanism reduces the recoil felt by the shooter.
USM calibration
Individual fitting of weapon parts allows you to achieve higher accuracy of hits when shooting.
Plastic store
This product of modern technology allows you to slightly reduce the overall weight of the weapon
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
Plastic parts
Replacing some standard metal parts with analogues made of heat-resistant plastic can significantly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Heavy Duty Parts
New parts made from modern refractory alloys have higher strength, which slows down the wear of the weapon and has a beneficial effect on its reliability.
